title: See keyword and identifier overlap
description: This example tests strings against both an identifier pattern and a keyword pattern.
source: draft: copilot free model + edit: codex

steps.description: ident accepts a letter or _ followed by letters, digits, or _ characters. kw lists three keyword alternatives.
The loop tests two keyword strings and two other identifier strings.

steps.question: Will 'if' match both patterns?
steps.answer: It matches ident as an identifier-shaped word and kw as one listed keyword.

steps.description: fullmatch produces one Boolean result for ident and one for kw for every test string.
The first output row shows that if belongs to both pattern-defined sets.
